components.name: Alert
components.use: Ask for confirmation of a consequential action or collect one short value, with two actions side by side or three or more stacked.
components.avoid: Choices that are not a yes/no decision or more than three actions; use ActionSheet, and use Banner for non-blocking feedback.
components.a11y: role=alertdialog with aria-modal, labelled by the title and described by the message; focus moves into the alert and Escape triggers the cancel action.

components.name: ActionSheet
components.use: Offer a short list of choices about one item (share, duplicate, delete) after the person taps a control.
components.avoid: Navigation or long option lists; use Menu for persistent commands and Sheet for anything with more content.
components.a11y: role=dialog with aria-modal; the cancel action is not drawn (outside tap dismisses) but stays available as a visually hidden button and on Escape.

components.name: Sheet

onClose.description: Called on a scrim tap, Escape, or a drag down past the dismiss threshold.

detents.description: Detents the user can drag between (.presentationDetents). Default: only `detent`.

onDetentChange.description: Called when a drag settles on another detent.

dismissDisabled.description: .interactiveDismissDisabled(): a drag down snaps back (unsaved changes).

onDismissAttempt.description: Called instead of onClose when dismissDisabled blocks a drag, scrim tap or Escape: show the Discard Changes action sheet here.

components.use: Present a focused task or detail (create, edit, inspect) over the current screen, medium for quick input and large for full forms. Put a NavigationStack inside for pickers that push within the sheet (one path, no modal over modal).
components.avoid: Confirmations and one-line messages; use Alert, and push a new screen for primary navigation.
components.a11y: role=dialog with aria-modal, labelled by the title; header buttons take their accessible names from cancel.label and confirm.label; Escape and scrim tap call onClose. Dragging is a pointer gesture only; keep the cancel button or Escape for keyboard and switch users.

components.name: Menu
components.use: Group secondary commands (sort, filter, view options, more actions) behind a button: titled sections, checkmarks for toggled state, one level of submenus, and a palette row of 3 (medium) or 4 (small) frequent actions.
components.avoid: Primary actions, long lists or deep hierarchies (submenus are one level, about 5 items); use Button, ActionSheet, Sheet or a List screen instead.
components.a11y: role=menu with menuitem / menuitemcheckbox (aria-checked) buttons; submenu items have aria-haspopup and open with Enter or ArrowRight (ArrowLeft/Escape go back); arrow keys move between items and Escape closes; small palette items are labelled by their label prop; destructive items are tinted red and should say what they delete.

components.name: ContextMenu

onPress.description: Tap action on the target (open the photo); a long press still opens the menu. Makes the target a button.

components.use: Touch-and-hold shortcuts for a piece of content (photo, card, row): the content lifts as a preview over a dimmed, blurred background with the menu below; also opens on right click and the context-menu key.
components.avoid: The only way to reach an action (it is hidden); keep each command reachable elsewhere and don't use it for primary actions or on controls that already respond to long press.
components.a11y: The target is focusable with aria-haspopup=menu and opens on the ContextMenu key or Shift+F10; the menu takes focus, Escape closes it and returns focus to the target; same item roles as Menu; give the target a label when its content isn't text.

components.name: Gauge
components.use: Show a level within a range at a glance, such as battery capacity or a reading on a scale.
components.avoid: Task progress over time; use ProgressView.
components.a11y: role=meter with aria-valuenow 0-100, labelled by label, with currentValueLabel as the value text.

components.name: EmptyState
components.use: Fill a screen or list that has no content yet, or no search results, with a short explanation and at most two actions.
components.avoid: Errors and loading; use ErrorState and ProgressView.
components.a11y: Title is a heading; the search variant is a status region so results changes are announced; the icon is decorative.

components.name: ErrorState
components.use: Replace content that failed to load with what went wrong and a retry button.
components.avoid: Validation messages on form fields or transient failures; use the field footer or a Banner.
components.a11y: Wrapped in role=alert so the failure is announced; the retry button shows a spinner and stays labelled while retrying.

components.name: Banner
components.use: Confirm a completed action or report a background event without blocking the screen, optionally with one undo-style action.
components.avoid: Decisions the person must make or errors that block the task; use Alert or ErrorState.
components.a11y: role=status (polite) for neutral and success, role=alert (assertive) for warning and danger; the close button needs dismissLabel; Escape dismisses.
